project: ArcadeRecomp — original The House of the Dead (hotdo), Sega Model 2C
disclaimer: SUBJECTIVE, rounded engineering estimates, NOT an objective coverage calculation or a statement of hardware fidelity. Component percentages and overall estimate are separately reviewed; never take a simple average. Code/tests completing a scoped task do not complete its parent platform.

overall.title: Faithful native HOTD1 PC port (original hotdo)
overall.scope: Original 1997 HOTD1 arcade behavior, faithfully playable end to end, with separately native-translated program and all Model 2C devices. Estimate NOT computed from child areas.
overall.next: First capture and implement 315-5649 authentic status/RX to advance uninterrupted original boot; then MB86235/video, sound and verified gameplay.

gates.name: Original HOTD1 main CPU AOT operational

areas.title: ROM authenticity & reconstruction

history.note: Initial subjective estimates transcribed from the project-wide progress report; NOT derived mathematically, not independently validated against all original cabinet behavior.

Added a bounded CPU-side serial-access trace with retained/dropped count metadata and strict rejection of incomplete captures. This hardens diagnostic integrity but does not supply any authentic Sega 315-5649 RX/status bytes or original cabinet timing; the 90% tooling estimate is unchanged.

Fixed the progress history baseline assertion to check the first immutable entry rather than the latest review. The new bounded trace/comparator tests passed under GCC and Clang, but full CI needs to rerun; subjective trace tooling and HOTD1 estimates remain unchanged.

Implemented opt-in four-channel 25 MHz tick-countdown and partial timer-to-IRQ source wiring using explicit externally supplied ticks; GCC/Clang synthetic tests exercise masking, independent expiry and fault preservation. Unknown reset, zero-load, post-expiry readback, actual cabinet cycle/IRQ timing, and CPU interrupt entry still halt or remain unmodeled. Parent Model 2C and overall HOTD1 percentages remain unchanged.

Required the strict native serial-access footer before comparing captures; missing summaries now fault instead of silently accepting truncated prefixes, with synthetic CLI and malformed-footer regression tests. This hardens the evidence boundary but does not add independently captured Sega serial RX/status bytes or Model 2C timing, so the 80% comparison-tool estimate, 20% Model 2C and 10% overall HOTD1 remain unchanged.

Added explicit fault-only CPU address classifications for Model 2C geometry interface, mirrored buffer, FIFO status and video control windows, with synthetic GCC/Clang UBSan address-boundary and native callback tests. This improves diagnosis but implements no MB86235 program execution, device register semantics, FIFO timing or rendering; map estimate stays 45%, Model 2C stays 20%, and original HOTD1 stays 10%.

Independently documented Model 2C MB86235 candidate 64-bit program staging from externally recorded pairs of 32-bit host writes and created a ROM-free bounded offline packing/metadata tool. Synthetic tests cover explicit endianness, low/high hypotheses, strict length and provenance validation, and private evidence preservation. This is research (15% estimate), NOT extraction of the actual HOTD1 upload, verified 64-bit opcode decoding, DSP execution, FIFO semantics, native AOT, or original-cabinet validation. Graphics overall stays 0%, Model 2C 20%, HOTD1 10%.

Resolved previously unmapped published Model 2C i960-side TGPx4 FIFO/program-upload, function, coprocessor control/status, and geometry program/control apertures; added precise fail-closed region classification and synthetic GCC/Clang UBSan boundary/CPU-callback tests. This corrects the typed bus map, not actual program upload acceptance, MB86235 execution, FIFO behavior, hardware timing or ROM/cabinet evidence. Estimated map task 45->50%; Model 2C overall remains 20%, original HOTD1 10%.

Added strict offline host-side TGPx4 control-bracketed write-transcript audit, rejecting incomplete/unsupported CPU FIFO captures and fingerprinting candidate 64-bit program slots without exporting proprietary bytes. ROM-free synthetic parser/CLI tests only; no actual original HOTD1 program upload or physical control-state proof. The TGPx4 research estimate remains 15%, graphics 0%, Model 2C 20%, HOTD1 overall 10%.

Added bounded opt-in native i960 geometry MMIO attempt tracing, private strict-boot --geometry-trace diagnostics, and synthetic native callback/probe tests. Refused writes have known attempted values but completed=no; refused reads remain UNOBSERVED and the accepted-upload tool cannot treat these as a real DSP program. No original HOTD1 upload, actual cabinet event stream, MB86235 opcode, FIFO acceptance or hardware timing proven; research 15%, graphics 0%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 10% remain unchanged.

CI caught and corrected two syntax-only comprehension typos in the new ROM-free geometry native test module; retained all fail-closed runtime behavior and original evidence limitations. Target metrics unchanged pending successful GCC/Clang regression results: TGPx4 research 15%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 10%.

Added bounded fail-closed exact CPU-side serial transaction replay to the opt-in private native strict-boot probe, with explicit per-read source bytes, original-byte transmit matching, missing/mismatched data refusal, terminal capture completeness checks and GCC/Clang ROM-free probe coverage. Synthetic fixture inputs can advance native CPU research but are NEVER authentic RX/status hardware proof; strict default unchanged. Software framework estimate 45->50%, authentic_rx 5%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 overall 10% unchanged.

CI on initial strict CPU-side serial replay branch passed the new GCC/Clang synthetic replay tests but exposed the pre-existing progress CLI regression using a hardcoded 45->50 increase. Updated the fixture test to derive an actual +5 percentage from current baseline rather than wrongly requesting a no-op update. Serial replay remains optional and unverified, authentic Model 2C RX/status behavior remains 5%, motherboard 20%, HOTD1 overall 10%.

Fixed lifetime and relocation safety of opt-in 315-5649 CPU-side serial replay callbacks. Replay is uniquely owned/movable with weak callback handles; destruction or disconnect now faults instead of dereferencing a stale pointer or returning fictional status/RX. Synthetic GCC/Clang UBSan tests cover moved-owner continuation and missing owner refusal. No original-cabinet bytes, protocol timings, startup progress or hardware fidelity established; rx_framework 50%, authentic_rx 5%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 10% unchanged.

Corrected C++ test-fixture escaped newline tokens for the new replay-owner move/destroy regression. The source fixture uses actual newline separators when parsed in native C++, not literal backslash-n text; replay runtime behavior and all authenticity claims are unchanged. Await CI verification.

Fixed native i960 local RET diagnostic so malformed restored caller RIP stops before mutating cached/spilled frame state or reload counters, preserving the actual stop IP and supporting safe correction/retry in synthetic GCC/Clang UBSan tests. This is fail-closed CPU diagnostic behavior, NOT proven original Intel fault-entry/restart timing or hardware fidelity. CPU frames 75%, CPU overall 55%, original HOTD1 10% unchanged.

Adjusted GCC/Clang C++17 native return-guard harness for portable -Wextra -Werror compilation: helper functions are inline and aggregate Bus callbacks initialized explicitly. No runtime or hardware semantics changed, CPU frames 75%, CPU 55%, original HOTD1 10%.

Added pure side-effect-free board-to-Intel 80960KB IRQ pin snapshot showing synthetic pending sources and configured ICR pin roles, without priority arbitration, timing or CPU interrupt acceptance. Exposed one authoritative provisional board source mask and tested all 4096 possible synthetic 12-bit pending masks with GCC/Clang UBSan. This is CPU IRQ research infrastructure (10% unchanged), NOT fault/interrupt entry, original board trace, verified IRQ signal timing or HOTD1 progress (10% overall).

Implemented independently documented Intel 80960KB interrupt vector priority/eligibility classification and pending-table bit/offset metadata; 8192 exhaustive ROM-free native vector/program-priority combinations and Sega-to-ICR candidate tests. Caller must explicitly supply known/hypothetical CPU priority, and all IAC/INTR/INTA/invalid vectors remain non-deliverable by this API. CPU IRQ subsystem estimate 10->15% for documented priority groundwork ONLY: no actual interrupt acceptance, pending-memory writes, pin arbitration, stack frame, source timing, original-board proof or authentic HOTD1 boot. CPU overall 55%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 overall 10% unchanged.

Corrected synthetic Intel ICR fixture byte fields to actually express the stated reserved/vector priority scenarios: vectors 12,245,20,16 at external priority1, and 16,255,20,12 at external priority31. Intel priority helper unchanged; this makes the exhaustive and integrated regression assertions meaningful, with no new hardware fidelity claims.

Added explicitly tracked initial Intel KB program priority after successful opt-in IAC 0x93, invalidated for ordinary frame_init, failed PRCB validation or out-of-band process-control modifications. Read-only IRQ observer now has a guarded known-CPU-priority API, refusing unknown state rather than assuming zero. ROM-free GCC/Clang UBSan integration tests cover provenance and pending-priority review. No MODPC handler, actual pending writes/interrupt delivery/frames or physical Model2C evidence; cpu.interrupts 15%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, HOTD1 10% unchanged.

Added native Intel KB MODPC 655h decode/AOT and conservative process-controls handling based on primary manual: mask-zero read and priority-only nondecreasing supervisor changes with old-PC destination, rejecting unknown process-control source, user privilege fault, unsupported fields and priority-lowering pending-check requirement. Synthetic GCC/Clang UBSan tests; no architected TYPE.MISMATCH fault, pending interrupt scan, actual IRQ delivery or cabinet proof. cpu.interrupts=15%, CPU 55%, HOTD1 overall 10% unchanged.

Pre-CI test audit corrected the synthetic MODPC priority replacement pattern so non-priority marker bits do not accidentally set priority bits; corrected one C++ literal spelling in modeled IAC setup. No runtime, Intel semantics or authenticity progress changed.

Implemented Intel 80960KB manual-based read-only 36-byte pending-interrupt record parser, priority/vector cross-check, reserved-vector refusal and highest potentially eligible vector selection for explicit current priority. ROM-free GCC/Clang UBSan tests cover 8192 vector/priority cases, mixed queues, corrupt records and unchanged MODPC priority-lowering guard. Does NOT read live CPU bus, lock the interrupt table, change pending state, service interrupts or prove real cabinet behavior; cpu.interrupts=15%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, original HOTD1 10% remain unchanged.

Hardened read-only Intel KB pending record evaluator so all reserved vector and priority-bitmap consistency checks finish before any eligible candidate fields can be populated. Invalid inputs cannot expose a misleading partial candidate; synthetic native regressions enforce zero eligible/candidate fields on malformed snapshots. No IRQ delivery or hardware fidelity progress claimed.

Added a fail-closed optional native CPU bus contract for provider-asserted coherent/locked 36-byte KB pending-table capture; StrictBus does not implement it and ordinary read32 cannot substitute. Validates known priority, aligned bounded table address, provider success and snapshot consistency before exposing metadata; refuses poisoned/partial data. Synthetic GCC/Clang native tests only. No actual Intel lock/atomic read-modify-write, pending memory updates, interrupt delivery, MODPC lowering or cabinet proof; cpu.interrupts remains 15%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, overall HOTD1 10%.

Implemented pure, uncommitted 36-byte Intel KB pending-vector post/take record drafts. Validated full original record before any output; support duplicate idempotency, priority/vector bit integrity, highest-vector tie order and final-vector priority clear. GCC/Clang UBSan synthetic exhaustive vector/current-priority and same-priority pair tests. No actual locked bus transaction, RAM commit, MODPC priority lowering, CPU interrupt frame or cabinet proof. cpu.interrupts 15%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, original HOTD1 10% unchanged.

Added a deliberately separate synthetic lock-protected pending-table transaction model to validate all-or-nothing post/take drafts, idempotency, revision tracking and fail-closed commit denial under GCC/Clang UBSan concurrent tests (192 distinct vectors and 12 writers/consumers). Not connected to native StrictBus or original CPU; C++ mutex is not Intel LOCK bus timing, no hardware atomic RMW, actual IRQ entry, MODPC priority-lowering or HOTD1 board evidence. cpu.interrupts 15%, native CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, original HOTD1 10% unchanged.

Corrected actual native i960KB frame_init reset boundary: a new root frame clears stale SAT, PRCB, interrupt/fault-table pointers, PRCB-loaded and pending IAC validity; validated opt-in IAC 0x93 installs newly captured PRCB after reset. Preserves cumulative reinitialize audit count and opt-in policy; invalid FP/IP checks do not partially reset. ROM-free GCC/Clang UBSan tests cover consecutive synthetic IACs and stale metadata refusal; no physical Model2C IRQ semantics or HOTD1 startup gain. cpu.reset remains 50%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, original HOTD1 10%.

Enforced caller-owned IAC 0x93 research opt-in inside the native helper as well as SYNMOVQ. Direct denied calls stop before bus access or reset mutation and preserve the request for explicit opt-in retry; synthetic native UBSan regression covers absent and throwing readers plus retry. No cabinet reset/timing proof or original boot gain; reset 50%, CPU 55%, Model2C 20%, original HOTD1 10% unchanged.

External CPU-side serial capture v2 now requires an explicit complete lossless acquisition window and exact event counts; rejects legacy unknown-completeness captures, dropped accesses, wrong summary types and cut-off exports before replacing comparison reports. Synthetic parser/CLI regression tests only; producer claims do not authenticate cabinet RX/status or timing. tools.serial_compare 80%, authentic RX 5%, Model2C 20%, overall original HOTD1 10% unchanged.
